object_revision.description: Object revision identifier, or an explicit statement that it is unknown.

configuration.description: Applicable object configuration, or an explicit statement that it is unknown.

components.description: Known component names or identifiers; record unresolved component identification in unresolved_inputs.

evidence_index.description: JSON text indexing evidence with IDs, sources, availability and provenance, or an explicit reason evidence is unavailable. Metadata does not establish media inspection.

requirements_register.description: JSON text recording identified requirements, IDs and provenance, or explicit unknowns. Preserve original requirement wording and distinguish tolerances from measurement uncertainty.

coordinate_and_scale_basis.description: Coordinate frame, units, scale basis and supporting evidence IDs; explicitly unknown is permitted.

unresolved_inputs.description: Named unresolved fields and dependencies, explicitly identifying critical gaps that hold dependent reconstruction. An empty array is not a readiness determination.
